mara.activity: Wake, make the bed, wash up, and change into workout clothes.
mara.intention: Start the day cleanly and avoid letting the deadline take over before I am ready.

mara.activity: Have a small glass of water and gather what I need before leaving for the workout.
mara.intention: Hydrate and get out the door without drifting into work messages.

mara.activity: Do the short strength workout and shower.
mara.intention: Keep the usual morning movement and arrive at work with a clear head.

mara.activity: Return, dress for the studio, and prepare a quick breakfast.
mara.intention: Get presentable and fed before the long workday.

mara.activity: Eat breakfast at the kitchen island and leave for the studio.
mara.intention: Have enough fuel for the morning without opening the presentation materials at home.

mara.activity: Work at the studio on the major presentation and planting-plan revisions, sorting priorities and tightening the visual logic.
mara.intention: Make the recommendations defensible while preserving the beauty and coherence of the scheme.

mara.activity: Take a brief lunch break and review the next decisions without answering nonessential messages.
mara.intention: Reset my attention before the afternoon site and client work.

mara.activity: Continue studio work, site visits, and client meetings, documenting final measurements and presentation changes.
mara.intention: Bring the deadline work to a coherent stopping point before the committee meeting.

mara.activity: Travel to the community garden committee meeting and take a few quiet minutes to organize my notes.
mara.intention: Shift from presentation decisions to the maintenance-budget discussion without carrying the whole studio meeting into it.

mara.activity: Attend the community garden committee meeting.
mara.intention: Stay constructive and specific during the maintenance-budget disagreements.

mara.activity: Walk home at an easy pace and let the meeting settle before checking work messages.
mara.intention: Use the transition to lower the controlled pressure rather than bringing it straight into the kitchen.

mara.activity: Make toast and scrambled eggs at the kitchen island, then eat alone with a glass of water.
mara.intention: Make a simple, sufficient dinner while Julian is at service and avoid ordering delivery.

mara.activity: Wash the skillet, plate, and fork, wipe the island, and set the keys on the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Leave the kitchen orderly enough that tomorrow does not begin with visual clutter.

mara.activity: Sit in the living room with a small glass of water and review only the presentation checklist, not the whole project.
mara.intention: Keep the final details contained so the deadline does not consume the evening.

mara.activity: Wash up, change into sleep clothes, and put my phone aside.
mara.intention: Create a definite end to work and prepare for sleep before Julian comes home late.

mara.activity: Read briefly in bed with the lights low, then put the paperback book and reading glasses on my nightstand.
mara.intention: Let my attention soften without starting another task.
Rest for the next workday and protect enough energy for the continuing deadline.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and ease into the morning without checking work messages.
julian.intention: Start quietly and give both of us a low-pressure morning.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Get ready for the first kitchen shift.

julian.activity: Grind coffee and make eggs with buttered toast, carrots, and fruit; carry a mug and plate to the dining table and eat slowly.
julian.intention: Have a familiar breakfast and offer Mara calm company without pressing her to explain the workday.

julian.activity: Clear the plate and mug to the sink, rinse them, and pack my backpack with the tablet, restaurant notebook, menu folder, and thermos.
julian.intention: Leave with the tools I need for prep and management.

julian.activity: Take the knife roll from the lower kitchen cabinet, fill the thermos, and carry the backpack, knife roll, and thermos out.
julian.intention: Be ready for deliveries and the prep list before the kitchen gets busy.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant prep, deliveries, and kitchen management; check quantities, organize the prep list, and work through the Wednesday inspection-preparation details without improvising around gaps.
julian.intention: Keep the kitchen orderly and prevent small delivery or compliance problems from becoming service problems.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, then put the knife roll back on the lower kitchen-cabinet shelf.
julian.intention: Unload the workday and make the nap possible without starting another task.

julian.activity: Nap and reset in the main bedroom.
julian.intention: Recover enough energy for the long dinner service.

julian.activity: Wake, drink water, eat a small yogurt and a little leftover pasta from the refrigerator, and sit quietly without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Refuel gently and keep decisions to a minimum before returning to work.

julian.activity: Brush my teeth, put on my jacket, collect the backpack and keys, and leave for the restaurant.
julian.intention: Make the transition back to service cleanly and on time.

julian.activity: Run dinner service and closing duties, keeping the team moving through prep, service, cleanup, and the final kitchen checks.
julian.intention: Deliver a steady service despite the Wednesday pressure and finish the close thoroughly.

julian.activity: Travel home, return the thermos beside the kitchen sink, drop my wallet and earplugs on the living-room coffee table, and take a hot shower.
julian.intention: End the workday and let the heat take the service noise out of my body.

julian.activity: Eat yogurt and a small portion of leftover pasta from the refrigerator, then brush my teeth without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Settle my stomach without creating another meal or another decision.

julian.activity: Change into sleep clothes, put my phone on its charger, and get into bed beside Mara.
julian.intention: Move directly into sleep after the late service.

julian.activity: Lie still and let the day go quiet.
julian.intention: Sleep rather than replaying the service or checking messages.
